model: Asset-Level Five-Lens Probability-Adjusted Economic Valuation Model with External Evidence Calibration

confidence.marketComparableProxy: low-to-medium-by-sector; primary transaction anchors available but direct asset comparability not established
confidence.incomeLicensingProxy: low; buyer-specific cash-flow and royalty evidence not established

externalEvidence.policy: External transaction evidence calibrates sector demand and confidence before it changes asset value. Mature-company transaction values or revenue multiples are not copied directly into pre-revenue or early-stage asset valuations.

replacementCostScope.status: current baseline is not yet represented as a fully componentized all-in replacement-cost audit
replacementCostScope.policy: Do not automatically uplift the current baseline. Audit architecture, research, QA/validation, security, deployment, documentation, data/model assets, productization, compliance, IP/licence qualification and programme management asset by asset while avoiding double counting.

definitions.replacementCost: Existing recreation/replacement-cost baseline for comparable current work product. IM20 does not assume that every architecture, research, QA, security, deployment, documentation, compliance, IP-cleanup or programme-management component is already fully captured.
definitions.marketComparableProxy: Modelled marketability indication using maturity, commercial-potential and sector factors. Primary-source transaction anchors now calibrate evidence confidence, but the figure is not a verified comparable-transactions valuation.
definitions.incomeLicensingProxy: Modelled monetization indication using maturity, commercial-potential and route-to-market factors. It is not a DCF or relief-from-royalty valuation because asset-specific revenue forecasts and royalty benchmarks are not established.
definitions.probabilityAdjustedStrategicValue: Replacement-cost anchored opportunity value adjusted for technical completion, commercialization probability, a rights/transfer diligence reserve, time/risk and sector context.
definitions.triangulatedEconomicReference: Weighted preliminary seller-side economic reference combining the four valuation lenses above. It is not certified market value.
definitions.sellerAsk: Existing seller-side asking reference, deliberately separate from economic-reference modelling.
definitions.externalEvidenceConfidence: A confidence measure for the existence and relevance of primary-source sector transaction evidence. It is not a valuation multiplier and does not establish direct comparability.

nextGates: Run asset-by-asset replacement-cost completeness audits without double counting.
Match subject assets to narrower precedent transactions or licences by rights, maturity, sector, geography, useful life and date.
Introduce defensible royalty benchmarks and buyer-specific income forecasts where commercialization routes are credible.
Replace generic technical and commercialization probabilities with asset-specific evidence.
Re-weight valuation lenses by asset according to evidence quality rather than applying one universal portfolio weighting.
